steps.name: And a KRS company is configured for NIP "5261040828"
And a COMPANY user is authenticated for registry tests
And the registry user has emailVerified set to true
And the registry user account status is set to "IN_VALIDATION"
When the user performs a registry lookup for NIP "5261040828"
Then the response status should be 200

expected 200; response body: {"nip":"5261040828","regon":"012345678","krs":"0000123456","companyName":"E2E Testowa Firma Sp. z o.o.","companyType":"SP_ZOO","legalFormName":"SPÓŁKA Z OGRANICZONĄ ODPOWIEDZIALNOŚCIĄ","street":"Marszałkowska","buildingNumber":"1","apartmentNumber":"10","city":"Warszawa","postalCode":"00-001","voivodeship":"MAZOWIECKIE","pkdMainCode":"62.01.Z","pkdMainDescription":"Działalność związana z oprogramo
When the user confirms company data for NIP "5261040828"
Then the response status should be 200

expected 200; response body: {"companyDataId":1,"nip":"5261040828","companyName":"E2E Testowa Firma Sp. z o.o.","companyType":"SP_ZOO","activated":true,"accountStatus":"ACTIVE","message":"Company verified and activated"}
And the confirm response activated should be true
And the confirm response accountStatus should be "ACTIVE"
When the registry user refreshes their session after activation
When the registry user checks unread notification count
Then the unread count should be at least 1
When the registry user fetches notifications page 0 size 10
Then the response status should be 200

expected 200; response body: {"content":[{"id":1,"type":"ACCOUNT_ACTIVATED","category":"ACCOUNT","priority":"HIGH","colorTheme":"amber","icon":"heroicons_outline:exclamation-circle","title":"Konto aktywowane!","message":"Twoje konto CheckItOut zostało aktywowane. Możesz korzystać ze wszystkich funkcji!","actionUrl":"/user/settings","actionLabel":"Odkryj platformę","isRead":false,"createdAt":"2026-11-07T08:30:35.292945","group
And the notifications response should contain type "ACCOUNT_ACTIVATED"
